root_cause.text: The SLB multihit error occurs because the preload_new_slb_context and slb_setup_new_exec functions attempt to insert SLB entries into the hardware SLB without ensuring synchronization with the software preload cache, leading to duplicate entries when a process migrates between CPUs without a full MMU context switch (due to the same-mm optimization skipping switch_mmu_context()).
root_cause.evidence: The CVE description's timeline shows that after an SLB entry is evicted from the software cache on CPU 1, migrating the process back to CPU 0 without calling switch_mmu_context() leaves the stale entry in hardware; then preload_new_slb_context tries to add the same entry again, triggering the multihit. The patch removes these two functions to prevent this redundant preload, as stated: "Removing these functions avoids redundant preloads and eliminates the multi-hit issue."
